sentences: Buss's bounded-arithmetic hierarchy organizes formal theories according to restricted reasoning principles.
The saved question asks to separate two levels of that hierarchy.
A separation would exhibit a statement provable with the stronger principles but unavailable in the weaker theory.
Such results connect logical induction strength with computational complexity and the formal resources needed to certify algorithms.
